final: WITH s1 AS (SELECT p.throws AS throws, COUNT(DISTINCT pa.player_id) AS c FROM player_award pa JOIN player p ON p.player_id = pa.player_id GROUP BY p.throws), s2 AS (SELECT SUM(c) AS tot FROM s1), s3 AS (SELECT s1.throws AS throws, s1.c AS c, CAST(s1.c AS REAL) / NULLIF(s2.tot, 0) AS share FROM s1 JOIN s2 ON s2.tot IS NOT NULL), s4 AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS av FROM s3), s5 AS (SELECT s3.throws AS throws, s3.c AS c, s3.share AS share, s3.share - s4.av AS diff FROM s3 JOIN s4 ON s4.av IS NOT NULL WHERE s3.share > s4.av) SELECT SUM(c), AVG(share), AVG(diff) FROM s5
